item: The saved-watch pass before Home's producers is bounded like a producer (R695, item 32's residual, Lane T)
summary: R666 bounded each briefing producer at 600 s, but evaluate_watches ran bare before them, its reads holding the write-ahead log's read mark with no limit, and its per-watch except would have taken the deadline's interrupt for one bad watch and stamped every watch it never evaluated. The pass now runs under the same bound (not armed under an enclosing deadline); a stop ends the pass, leaves the unreached watches unstamped so the next refresh evaluates them, and Home names A watch matched as missing (no new string, no repair loop). The loop runs with autoflush off and the refresh flushes after the deadline exits, so no write is interrupted; firings before the stop are kept.
